<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1834695_risk_a_0.update_inhRisk</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>update_inhRisk</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var update_inhRisk = Class.create();
update_inhRisk.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
	// https://www.servicenow.com/community/developer-articles/how-to-call-script-include-from-client-script-servicenow/ta-p/2313654

	//Function that calculates the inh_risk value
	updateInhRisk: function(){
		// In code pass int_impact / int_likelihood as parameters
		// Here are the required parameters 
		var impact  = this.getParameter('impact');
		var likelihood = this.getParameter('likelihood');
		
		var int_inh_risk = impact * likelihood;

		// I create a JSON object so that I can properly return the number
		obj = {};
		obj.int_risk = int_inh_risk;
		gs.info('The script Include that gets the Inh_Risk value was executed! ' + JSON.stringify(obj));
		return JSON.stringify(obj);
	},

	// Function that changes the inh_risk from a number to Text
	getInhRiskString : function(){
		var int_inh_risk = parseInt(this.getParameter('intInhRisk'));
		// works!

		switch(int_inh_risk){
			case 1: case 2:
				inh_risk = "Low";
			break;
			case 3: case 4: case 6:
				inh_risk = "Medium";
			break;
			case 8: case 9:
				inh_risk = "High";
			break;
			case 12: case 16:
				inh_risk = "Critical";
			break;
		}
		// End of the code that should be on a seperate file
		
		gs.info("The returned inh_risk must be :" + inh_risk);
		obj = {};
		obj.text_risk = inh_risk;

		return JSON.stringify(obj);
	},

    type: 'update_inhRisk'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-03 17:26:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>9396f7a03bc13210f0d15f0f23e45aa8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>22</sys_mod_count><sys_name>update_inhRisk</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Risk-AB-Mock" source="x_1834695_risk_a_0">de34e7633b34b210f0d15f0f23e45aea</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Risk-AB-Mock">de34e7633b34b210f0d15f0f23e45aea</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9396f7a03bc13210f0d15f0f23e45aa8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-04 16:40:08</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
